To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
manganese fertilizers can improve the growth and competitive ability of northern red oak, chestnut oak, and red maple seedlings.

the addition of MnCl2· 4H2O, Mn(OH2), or nanoparticle Mn(O2) to a growing medium mixture containing a peat moss, Perlite, and sand substrate, can increase the germinability and growth of oak species while reducing the growth of maple species, and therefore creating a competitive advantage of oak over its competitor in North America oak forests.

the addition of Mn fertilizers to the growing medium of oak and maple seeds in a greenhouse can significantly increase the germination rate of the oak seeds, while decreasing the germination rate and growth of maple.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a method of producing more vigorous oak seedlings in order to increase the competitive advantage of oak over red maple in the regeneration of oak forest ecosystems.
improving oak regeneration in North American oak forest ecosystems by using manganese fertilizer treatments to improve seedling vigor.
improving oak seedling growth and competitive ability in order to restore oak forest ecosystems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the application of manganese fertilizer can increase the growth of oak seedlings and reduce the growth of red maple seedlings, thus creating a favorable competitive environment for oak over red maple.

the MnCl2 · 4H2O fertilizer treatment produced the most significant increase in germination and growth for the oak species and red maple in the substratum, and the nanoparticle Mn (OH)2 fertilizer treatment produced the greatest increase in growth for chestnut oak seedlings.

the addition of the MnCl2 · 4H2O fertilizer to the growing medium of the oak seedlings produced the most vigorous and competitive seedlings of northern red oak, and chestnut oak, while suppressing the growth of red maple.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the application of the Mn(OH), Mn(OH) nanoparticle, and MnCl2· 4H2O treatments can improve seedling growth, germination rates, and foliar nutrient content of oak species, while reducing red maple germination and growth.
the application of manganese fertilizers to oak seedlings will improve the germination and seedling growth of oak seedlings, while suppressing the germination and/or growth of red maple seedlings.
the application of manganese fertilizers can increase germination and growth in oak species, while having a lesser effect and in some cases reducing germination and growth on red maple.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application of a chemical compound of MnCl2· 4H2O can increase the germinability and growth of red oak and chestnuts while suppressing the growth of red maple.
MnCl2·2H2O and manganese hydroxides are promising fertilizers that can be used to increase the vigor of oak seedlings in forest regeneration efforts.
the addition of manganese fertilizers to oak seeds can be a viable method to increase the growth of oak seedlings, which may help restore the oak forest ecosystems in the eastern United States.
